description: Données sur les productions locales d'énergie renouvelable - 2016 - CC VAL2C is a dataset listed in Val-de-Cher-Controis open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by LIG'AIR-OREGES. Diffusion de données sur les productions d'énergies renouvelables à la maille de la Communauté de communes Val-de-Cher-Controis. Coverage: Val-de-Cher-Controis (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are PCAET, photovoltaïques, énergie. The portal shows 33 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-val2c-fr-portal.
